grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Week 8 Listening: A Busy Saturday
instructions: 这是为成人英语初学者设计的模拟听力练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答8个问题。题目包括单选题和填空题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定的词数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript: A: Hi, Mei. How was your weekend? B: It was busy. On Saturday morning, I was at the library. A: Was it quiet? B: No, it was noisy because many students were there. A: What did you do? B: I read a book and I wrote a list. Then I was hungry, so I went to a café. A: Did you meet anyone? B: Yes, I met my friend Li. We were happy because the coffee was good. A: Are you going to go again next Saturday? B: No, I'm not. I'm going to visit my parents because it's my mother's birthday. A: That sounds nice. B: Yes, I'm going to buy a gift for her.

questions.prompt: Mei 星期六上午在哪里？
questions.explanation: 录音中 Mei 说：'On Saturday morning, I was at the library.' 所以选“在图书馆”。
questions.evidence: On Saturday morning, I was at the library.

questions.explanation: A 问 'Was it quiet?'，Mei 回答 'No, it was noisy because many students were there.' 所以图书馆是吵闹的。
questions.evidence: No, it was noisy because many students were there.

questions.prompt: Mei 在图书馆做了什么？她读了一本书，还写了一个 ______。
questions.explanation: Mei 说：'I read a book and I wrote a list.' 所以填 list。
questions.evidence: I read a book and I wrote a list.

questions.prompt: Mei 为什么去了咖啡馆？
questions.explanation: Mei 说：'Then I was hungry, so I went to a café.' 所以是因为她饿了。
questions.evidence: Then I was hungry, so I went to a café.

questions.prompt: Mei 在咖啡馆见到了谁？她见到了她的朋友 ______。
questions.explanation: Mei 说：'Yes, I met my friend Li.' 所以填 Li。
questions.evidence: Yes, I met my friend Li.

questions.prompt: Mei 和 Li 为什么高兴？
questions.explanation: Mei 说：'We were happy because the coffee was good.' 所以是因为咖啡好。
questions.evidence: We were happy because the coffee was good.

questions.prompt: Mei 下周六打算再去咖啡馆吗？
questions.explanation: A 问 'Are you going to go again next Saturday?'，Mei 回答 'No, I'm not.' 所以她不打算去。

questions.prompt: Mei 下周六打算做什么？她打算去看望她的 ______。
questions.explanation: Mei 说：'I'm going to visit my parents because it's my mother's birthday.' 所以填 parents。
questions.evidence: I'm going to visit my parents because it's my mother's birthday.

vocabulary.example: It was noisy because many students were there.
We were happy because the coffee was good.
I'm going to visit my parents.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was/were 谈论过去的状态。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。例如：I was at the library. We were happy. 我们用 be going to 谈论计划。例如：I'm going to visit my parents. 注意：be 动词要随主语变化（am/is/are）。
grammar.example: I was at the library. We were happy because the coffee was good. I'm going to visit my parents.

questions.explanation: 主语 I 的过去时 be 动词是 was，所以选 'I was at home yesterday.'
主语 They 的过去时 be 动词是 were，所以选 'They were happy.'
questions.evidence: We were happy because the coffee was good.

options: She is going to visit her parents.
She are going to visit her parents.
She going to visit her parents.
answers: She is going to visit her parents.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 的 be 动词是 is，所以选 'She is going to visit her parents.'
questions.evidence: I'm going to visit my parents.

options: We is going to buy a gift.
We are going to buy a gift.
We was going to buy a gift.
answers: We are going to buy a gift.
questions.explanation: 主语 We 的 be 动词是 are，所以选 'We are going to buy a gift.'
questions.evidence: I'm going to buy a gift for her.
